events.title: The Infinite Library is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: I've put The Infinite Library into Steam Next Fest this week. The demo is free, about 30 to 60 minutes, and ends at the first Redraft, which is where the strangeness starts. It's an incremental game about a library that reads itself. You write words, words become books, books fill shelves, and after a while you start to notice the Library has opinions about what you're doing. No cutscenes. events.title: New key art
events.summary: The Infinite Library has new key art. It was painted by Komarca Art, who I commissioned back in August. Everything you can see on the store page now comes from him. The capsules, the logotype, the library itself. Why The old capsule was mine, made with AI image tools, and it was a placeholder from the start. It did a job while I got the game finished.
